title: GUARD: Stabilizing Recursive Self-Improvement with Regret Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2611.23476v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous AI agents pair a frozen base model with an editable harness of prompts, skills, tool rules, and memory. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) adapts this harness from experience without weight updates, yet self-editing without external graders often backfires: reflection and scalar scores conflate what an edit newly broke with what remains unsolved, causing local regressions, skill forgetting, and memory bloat. We introduce GUARD (Grader-free Unsupervised Environment Design [UED] with Adaptive Rule Distillation), a closed-loop framework for reference-free continual harness evolution. Our key insight is to decompose each task into pre-execution self-checks and guide harness updates via directional regret. Each round grades trajectories against these checks, pinning mastered rules while prioritizing newly broken behaviors, and selects among parallel candidate edits by critic-free group-relative fitness. A Soft-HURT gate then promotes

translated_title: GUARD：基于遗憾引导稳定递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 自主AI智能体将冻结的基础模型与一个可编辑的框架相结合，该框架包含提示词、技能、工具规则和记忆。递归自我改进（RSI）无需更新权重即可根据经验调整这一框架，然而在缺乏外部评估器的情况下进行自我编辑往往会适得其反：反思和标量分数将编辑新破坏的内容与尚未解决的问题混为一谈，导致局部性能退化、技能遗忘和记忆膨胀。我们提出GUARD（带有自适应规则蒸馏的无评估器无监督环境设计[UED]），这是一个无需参考标准的持续框架演化闭环框架。我们的关键洞察是将每个任务分解为执行前的自检项，并通过方向性遗憾来引导框架更新。每一轮根据这些自检项对轨迹进行评分，在巩固已掌握规则的同时优先修复新破坏的行为，并通过无评论家的组相对适应度在并行候选编辑中进行选择。随后，Soft-HURT门控机制提升（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: GUARD提出了一种无评估器的闭环框架，通过将任务分解为执行前自检并用方向性遗憾引导框架更新，稳定AI智能体的递归自我改进，避免局部退化、技能遗忘和记忆膨胀。
en_tdlr: GUARD introduces a grader-free closed-loop framework that stabilizes recursive self-improvement by decomposing tasks into pre-execution self-checks and guiding harness updates via directional regret, preventing local regressions, skill forgetting, and memory bloat.
